nom: The INKEY List Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Face Serum

avis.titre: I don't love it; it's just so-so
avis.texte: I picked this up at Ulta, along with another hyaluronic acid serum. I have been using this one as of late as I am trying to find the perfect serum for me. I use the recommended pea-sized amount, morning and night, before my moisturizer. It's just ok—it doesn't really have a wow factor for me, so I won't be repurchasing. It's not a bad product; just not for me. For reference, I am 46 and have sensitive, combination skin.

My skin tends to be dry during the winter months, so I use this for an extra layer of hydration. This is my second time purchasing. I don't use it everyday but 2 or 3 times a week is good enough for me. So far no complaints.

I love this hyaluronic acid serum. So Light and yet moisturising. Since getting the free gift I've been using it on my neck and have noticed a big difference in skin texture - much smoother and less crepey
Super hydrating, non sticky, doesn't irritate the skin. Highly recomend.
Have been using this serum for a few years now, wouldn't be without it

I absolutely love thia serum on my 4th bottle and probably NEED to get my fith or 6th already because I use it soo much and its THE BEST serum ever!!! Really Hydrating, good foe ALL SKIN TYPES. It's really Hydrating and gives u a subtle glow good for Oily & Combination!!

avis.titre: Use it after every face wash
avis.texte: Excellent. Love it as a base for every other skin product. I use it on my uooer arms before moisturiser and it really helps. Will purchase the large size next time.
I got an acne prone skin and this serum moisturise my skin very well with out giving me any breakout.
I always use this to keep my hydration up. My skin loves it and I can tell when I don't use it. I like this one from inkey a lot and I don't know how many times I've repurchased it, but it's a lot.

I have not had any issues with this product so far. Easy to apply, does not bother my sensitive skin. I can't tell a huge difference since I've only been using it for 3 days, but I plan to continue using it.

My skin feels so hydrated and soft after this. Does not create any slimy cast and absorbs beautifully. The only thing I'd definitely change is the packaging... I'm really not a fan, it doesn't feel as sterile as a dropper and often wastes product by squeezing out too much
I'm using this alongside a couple of other Inkey products and the routine has done wonders for my skin - no more dry or flaky areas and feels hydrated all day long
Really hydrating product, non greasy and leaves my skin feeling smooth and soft.
The hyaluronic acid is nice on my skin.Smooth my dry skin. I Like it alot.
Always in my routine! Love the price point, texture, feel and packaging. Even though this was a free one I always order it.
I can't count the bottles I have bougth. It is my favourite hyaluronic acid.

I like the texture of it. I have been using it for years. I like it is vegan formula and how it feels on my skin. I dont see changes on my skin tho but it glows the first periof after using it. I would like to have again the 100 ml size.
Gave my skin a luminosity and moisturiser seemed to absorb better.
Use this on my skin everyday under my make up . No stickiness and drys instantly on the skin
Tried quite a few HA but settled on this one , well done Inkey

Good for hydration. But I have a question: are the big molecules being treated for penetration? Such as an increase in the electronic level. If not, they're still doing the job of hydrating I believe but not so much on the plumping part.
So love this serum really suits my sensitive skin, have tried them all from inkey they are all great, inkey skin care range is the best.
I only received this serum this morning, only used it twice but I can already feel a difference in my skin! It feels smooth, soft and moisturised. I highly recommend this serum to everyone!
Have been using this serum for years. Great stuff. It will always be in my skin care kit.

avis.titre: A Must-Have for Hydrated, Plump Skin
avis.texte: I've been using hyaluronic acid serum for a while now, and this one has quickly become a favourite. I apply it right after cleansing while my skin is still damp, and it makes such a difference, my face feels softer and smoother, and makeup goes on way better. It doesn't feel sticky or heavy at all, just refreshing and hydrating.
This product is one of three Inky products I use every day and wouldn't be with out it , my skin is in brilliant condition
Love the thickness of this product and fast absorption. Size of bottle is great as well as price point.
Love this serum, seems to instantly add moisture to and plump my skin as it's intended. I love that it specifies to use it before other serums too. Just a little small so it won't last long!

avis.titre: I never run out of this!
avis.texte: Holy grail of hydration. I always take advantage of sales to restash. Haha. Love it! 100%
It's a good serum for hydration, it also contains peptides on top of hyaluronic acid
I purchase more of this with every order. I have combo skin and this just soaks right in and makes my skin feel so much better. Now that I've used this I will never go without.
I love using this, every day and night, right before my moisturizers. It hydrates my skin without feeling greasy.
I tried a lot of HA serums and all of them were sticky. This one is not, it¬¥s light and absorbs well. No noticeable plumping effect.
Noticed a difference in my skin since adding this to my skincare routine, my skin looks and feels glowy and smoother, it absorbs well and I'll definitely be repurchasing.

While I've been dealing with random dry patches on my otherwise oily skin, I've really gotten lots of help from this product in my routine. It has really helped hydrate the spots that need it and maintains the spots that are at my goal.
I have sensitive combo skin that becomes dry in winter so this has been great at giving me an extra layer of hydration. Layers well with other products without breaking me out or pilling

I got this serum as a bonus with my purchase and it's been very soothing on days where I've been out in the sun. It's got a bit of a tacky dry-down texture which is fine because I put it on under a face oil. I like that it's fragrance free. I'm not sure I notice a big difference in hydration but I haven't been using it consistently so that's on me. I wish it came in a different applicator as I often find that I've dispensed more product that I need but I put the extra on the back of my hands.
I love the bigger size. It's great value. I've also had so many people comment on my lack of wrinkles. I am 4 months into using this everyday and it works.
No frills and no fancy packaging. Brilliant serum at a competitive price
It's my first time using this serum, I found it best for my dry and sensitive skin.
Love this product and use it daily. It's light weight and as well as using on my face I apply to lips to plump them daily. It really works. ! I recommend this to all my friends who also swear by it.
This lasts ageeeees, I love it, I use it every pm after cleansing and before my retinol. Seriously hydrating!

avis.titre: Love that they come in 100 mL now!
avis.texte: I use this every day and love that we can buy in bulk to stock up for longer.

Perfect in the sense of the absence of side-effects despite having a very sensitive skin. I'm really sensitive to UVs, my skin is really dry and i use to have redness. I'm using this product daily mixed with pure sesame oil before going to bed. Clearly largely water based, no smell, really reassuring, and has a positive impact on my skin without any side-effect whatsoever. Don't change the formula!

Love this hyaluronic acid serum. It's just that, simple. This allows me to use other ingredients as I wish. Normally this type of serum has other ingredients in it. That does not agree with my skin but this one is great. Would prefer the packaging to be different- maybe a dropper wound be more convenient for application.
Always repurchase this as it works amazingly and hydrates my skin.
My skin feels so much better and less irritated since using them.
Is good product lightweight and plumping my skin absorbs it fast and stay looking hydrated. However, I might need to use it longer to see the soothing and firming effect.

Great product at a great price! Bought the smaller bottle before but upgraded as I use it every day in the morning. Just two drops ia enough or you cab out all over face, even lips! It greatly reduces the appearance of fine lines on my forehead, mouth, neck etc. Some much needed hydration! Highly recommend. It's not always wrinkles, some times it's just fine lines that need to be hydrated

I use this before applying makeup and it comes o ur so good. Definitely hydrates the face even on a normal day and adds that glowy bounce to the skin. Would definitely recommend and need to reorder again!
Feels so nice and hydrating on the skin and also absorbs quickly so you can go on to your next steps in your routine.

Overall I'm happy with this product. I use it on a need basis, when my skin feels a bit dehydrated or after retinol nights to make sure I protect my skin barrier with hydration + moisture. Layers well with my gel moisturiser and SPF from another brand. Not sure about repurchasing but for those looking for an extra hydration step I do recommend.

I have very dry skin and use both this serum and the Ectoin Hydro-Barrier serum. I love both, but this one gives more immediate relief. I always go for the !00ml (or 100ml duo) because I can't get enough. I use this one after cleansing and then the Ection Hydro-Barrier serum both twice a day and it not only feels great, but the Hyaluronic acid is working for long-term improvement. It feels heavenly, massaging in the serum. Highly recommended, especially for people with dry skin.
I'm always stocked up on this product. It really moisturises and plumps the skin. It's a joy to use.
If I was stranded on a desert island and could only take one skin care item...it would be this bottle of magic!
This is always what I use straight after cleansing before any other serums. It seems to make whatever I put on top work of my skin next, work better and makes my skin feel hydrated.
This is basic serum but really nice, I mix this with my Vitamin C every day.
I am a huge fan of this serum! It doesn't feel sticky or foam up like other brands. Leaves my skin plump amd hydrated

I decant this into a dropper bottle because I'm not sure who decided to put a liquid into a bottle with this kind of cap, but it's a terrible idea. It doesn't dispense evenly, no precision, and if I use this (or any of the serums in similar bottles) it always crusts up the lid or makes a mess. I find that the Inkey List has great formulations (this hyaluronic acid is a little ‚Äòslipperier' than other formulations I've tried but it does the job) but their packaging is not amazing.
I love this product. A little goes a long way. It makes my skin feel plumped and glowing. It works well alongside other inkey products
I use this serum right after cleansing and my face absorbs the product beautifully. Additionally moisturizer and all set to go!
This has been in my routine for years. It keeps the moisture in and my skin loves it.
Wow what an incredible face serum. I apply it before using my moisturiser as it makes my skin feel and look more hydrated and soft. Easy to apply and has a great consistency to.

Ever since I began using this stuff everyone seems genuinely shocked I'm 33. They all say they think in my mid 20s?! Which is honestly not something I strive for, but I'm so happy my skin looks so young and healthy!!
This is The best hyaluronic serum out there. My forever go to hydration product.
As a first layer it is quickly absorbed and gets along with others
I tried the 30ml a year ago, it really helped my skin stay hydrated.
Such a great serum, really makes my skin feel plump and refreshed
Great for hydration! Safe for sensitive skin, and fragrance-free! Recommend!!!
This serum hydrates my skin (I have ezcema and my skin is quite dry). I've used it for my lips and as a lash serum, and it worked very well.
Name says it all. Few weeks and already less wrinkles, skin is smooth and shiny

avis.titre: A staple in mybskin care routine.
avis.texte: Would never be without this. So hydrating, but not tacky at all. Leaves my dry, mature skin looking perfectly plump.

Love this so much I've already bought the bigger bottle. Hydrates really well for my skin. I'm 40 and still fighting the occasional breakout while also dealing with a few fine lines. This feels really nice on my skin.
